0.heading: Overview
refs: 2Ch 15:1 , Asa, with Judah and many of Israel, moved by the prophecy of Azariah the son of Oded, make a solemn covenant with God
2Ch 15:16 , He puts down Maachah his mother for her idolatry
2Ch 15:18 , He brings dedicated things into the house of God, and enjoys a long peace.
